external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
external_entities.notes: Users may be admins or viewers.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and opens the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, which manages invoices and customer data, enqueues PDF render jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time, reads the invoice from the tenant database and writes the PDF to the PDF bucket

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console available from the support office network that lets a support agent open a billing-app session as a customer user.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket where rendered PDFs are stored under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer user requests and submits billing-app operations.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; second factor: none

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: Payer follows an invoice link and receives the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: Billing app sends an invoice link to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: invoice link ending in the invoice number

data_flows.name: read and write invoices
data_flows.description: Billing app reads and writes tenant data in the shared database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: Billing app places a PDF render job on the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: PDF under the company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: Billing app fetches PDFs from the shared bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.authentication: own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: Admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary; each customer company is one tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network. The admin console is reachable only from there

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer records and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered PDFs of invoices and related bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes invoice PDFs to the bucket, and the payment page includes company bank details.
